wanted: Contract: a way to require or prefer items[].media, so bento's photo lead can be chosen only when the first item has a photo
Kit: a disclosure utility for accordion rows (hides the native marker, draws an open/closed sign that turns on open); nav-dropdown was borrowed for its marker and fixed ▾
Sheet tool: an option to render items with photos; the typical cards fixture has none, so item-photo variants show no photos on the sheet (a scratch preview script outside the repo was used instead)
An icon set: items carry icon names but no icons are drawn
notes: Both checks passed on the first run and every rerun. Review rounds changed the header (split only with a subhead, headline over two thirds), the bento small tiles (text at the foot), the bento lead's minimum height, and the accordion marker size.
